blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No player won the jackpots in the Grand Lotto 6/55 and Lotto 6/42 draws on Saturday, Sept. 19, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 06-05-12-17-47-03 for a jackpot of ₱209.01 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. READ: No jackpot winners in Sept. 18
